verdict.rationale: incident.io's Investigations feature starts automatically the moment an incident is declared, so it runs before a human asks. It gathers similar past incidents, change events, recent code changes, telemetry, logs, runbooks, and stack traces. It forms and tests hypotheses against code and telemetry, refines them as signals land, and pressure-tests them with an adversarial agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of investigation accuracy, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
